newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda plans output on three extra days.
newsitem.headline: Mazda plans output on three extra days.

text.p: Mazda Motor Corp will operate its Ujina No. 1 plant in Hiroshima, western Japan, for an extra three days in October to raise production of its new Demio recreational vehicle, a spokesman said on Wednesday.
Mazda plans to boost output of the Demio to 7,700 units in October from a planned 7,000 in September, the spokesman said.

Mazda, owned 33.4 percent by Ford Motor Co, also said it had received 14,500 domestic orders for Demios in the first three weeks after its launch, nearly triple its initial monthly sales target of 5,000.
